Since $\alpha \geq \mathfrak{c}$, we have $\alpha^{\aleph_0} \geq \mathfrak{c}$, so $\operatorname{card}(X) = \alpha^{\aleph_0} = \alpha$.

Thus $X = \ell^2(\alpha)$ is a Banach space with $\operatorname{card}(X) = \alpha$. $\square$
